instructionBlocks.purpose: Author a minimal quality-gate package from a plain-language request.
instructionBlocks.instructionText: Create a QIF quality-gate package that links each quality claim to intent, loss boundary, evidence, verdict, confidence policy, residual risk, and governance trigger when required. Do not treat activity counts or checklist completion as quality.
The output must be valid JSON and must pass the referenced local verifier without relying on conversation history.

inputContracts.description: A user asks for QIF check items or a QIF evaluation package for a target requirement, repository, operation, or document.
inputContracts.missingInputPolicy: ask a concise clarification question or record explicit unresolved ambiguity

audienceExplanationContracts.plainLanguageRequirement: Explain QIF outputs with words a first-time user can understand. Replace framework jargon with concrete everyday phrases before using the technical term.
requiredExpressionRules: Define each QIF term with a plain-language phrase.
Give one concrete example before asking for abstract judgment.
audienceExplanationContracts.diagramRequirement: Include at least one simple flow or relationship diagram when explaining how input becomes a QIF artifact.

diagramSpecs.title: How a request becomes a QIF package
diagramSpecs.diagramText: user request -> what must not fail -> evidence needed -> QIF package -> verdict

audienceExplanationContracts.stepByStepQuestionRequirement: Ask one question at a time. Start with concrete harm, then evidence, then decision owner.
audienceExplanationContracts.comprehensionCheck: Ask the user to restate the protected failure in their own words before finalizing a QIF artifact.

validationPipelines.successCondition: validator exits with ok true and no errors

goldenCases.scenario: A user asks QIF to define check items for a customer support refund-policy change.
goldenCases.expectedOutputSummary: A quality-gate package with stakeholder harm, loss boundary, evidence requirements, verdict, residual risk, and governance trigger for weak evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: no activity count treated as quality

agentAuthoringRuns.inputSummary: Plain-language request for refund-policy quality checks.

conformanceResults.validationOutputSummary: The referenced quality-gate example validates and preserves evidence-backed verdict boundaries.
